desc: The Smith & Wesson Performance Center M&P9 Shield EZ 9mm Handgun is an internal hammer-fired action pistol with an 8 + 1 capacity. The Performance Center lightweight trigger provides crisp action and includes a tactile and audible trigger reset, while the PC ported barrel reduces muzzle flip. The integrated TLCI informs you when the chamber is loaded, and the lightening cuts in the slide offer reduced weight.
